========================================
StarAxis Space Strategy Game - Native Distribution
========================================

[START GAME]
1. Double-click "StarAxis.bat" to start the native game client
2. The LWJGL3/OpenGL game window will open directly
3. The browser/web UI is not started by this launcher

[FILE DESCRIPTION]
- StarAxis.jar        : Native game client executable
- StarAxis.bat        : Native client launcher (uses bundled JDK)
- StarAxis-Debug.bat  : Debug launcher (shows verbose logs)
- README.txt          : This file
- openjdk-21.0.2/     : Bundled JDK (DO NOT DELETE)
- assets/             : Game assets
- saves/              : Save games directory (auto-created)

[SYSTEM REQUIREMENTS]
- Windows 10/11 64-bit
- RAM: 4GB+ (8GB recommended)
- OpenGL-compatible GPU/driver
- No Java installation required (bundled openjdk-21.0.2 included)

[NOTES]
1. DO NOT delete or move openjdk-21.0.2 folder, or game won't start
2. Current default startup path is the native LWJGL3 client
3. webnet/web are kept for gateway/debug/AI console work, not default startup

[TROUBLESHOOTING]
If game won't start:
1. Check if openjdk-21.0.2 folder exists
2. Run StarAxis-Debug.bat to see detailed error messages
3. Update GPU drivers if the OpenGL window fails to initialize
